name: yamlet-skills
description: Spec-driven development with yamlet: an interviewing author drills you down to minimal, testable `.yamlet.yaml` specs with EARS acceptance criteria, appending through the `yamlet` CLI so the file is correct by construction (the CLI owns all serialization and IDs). Two adversarial challengers guard the one-way init and commit gates, a verifier closes the loop, and a tester projects the specs into a Gherkin feature tree. A tech spec skill then plans the work against your code — a verdict per criterion, a task list covering every unmet one — and an ADR skill records each decision as a frozen `.adr.yaml` linked into the spec, whose obligations the tasks must cover. Requires the `yamlet` CLI on PATH.
